recognize_zh: 中央一顆大小正常、未脹大的紅血球內同時有兩個纖細的環狀滋養體，各帶一個深紅色染色質點，單一紅血球多重感染加上細環形態，是惡性瘧（P. falciparum）的典型線索。
features: Normal-sized red cell containing two delicate ring-form trophozoites (multiply infected red cell)
Each ring has a thin rim of blue cytoplasm and a single dark red chromatin dot
Infected red cell is not enlarged and lacks Schüffner stippling
A separate red cell (upper left) with a small dark chromatin body that may be another early ring
Background normocytic red cells and scattered small platelets; no gametocytes or schizonts in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells, one of which contains two small delicate ring-form trophozoites, each with a single chromatin dot. The infected cell is not enlarged and shows no Schüffner stippling, and a second red cell contains a small chromatin body suggestive of an additional ring. Mature trophozoites, schizonts and banana-shaped gametocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium infection, most suggestive of P. falciparum; quantify parasitemia and confirm species urgently.

ddx.vs: Babesia rings are pleomorphic, may be extracellular or form tetrads, and lack hemozoin pigment and gametocytes, often in an asplenic patient with tick exposure.
P. vivax infects enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots and shows thicker amoeboid trophozoites; multiple rings per cell are uncommon.
Early rings may look similar, but later stages show band-form trophozoites and rosette schizonts, and species confirmation requires PCR.
Artifacts lie in a different focal plane and lack the combination of a blue cytoplasmic ring with a discrete red chromatin dot.
